# Engineering (Arabic) — David Awad

**URL:** https://davidaw.ad/ar/engineering
**LLM version:** https://davidaw.ad/ar/engineering/llms.txt

مشاريع مختارة في البرمجيات وتعلم الآلة والأنظمة المدمجة والتقنية القانونية.

---
## fpml-rs — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/fpml-rs)
Typed Rust bindings for FpML credit default swap confirmations: parse ISDA's XML into real types, read the headline terms, and write it back without silently dropping elements.

## cftc-rs — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/cftc-rs)
Read the CDS market from the free DTCC public swap tape: any date range, typed trades, daily spread series per company or index, and bond-to-ticker mapping (Rust library and CLI).

## hetzner-rs — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/hetzner-rs)
Rust client for the Hetzner Cloud API, generated from the official OpenAPI spec, with a blocking shim, idempotent-only retry and secret redaction.

## ubicloud-rs — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/ubicloud-rs)
Rust client for the Ubicloud API, generated from the official OpenAPI spec with a blocking shim, retry backoff and secret redaction.

## whatsapp-link — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/whatsapp-link-rs)
Rust library and CLI that links a WhatsApp account and reads and sends messages by driving wuzapi over stdio JSON-RPC.

## slack-impersona — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/slack-impersona-rs)
Rust client and CLI for Slack's Web API that authenticates with a browser session's token and cookie instead of a registered Slack app.

## wherebox-cli — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/wherebox-cli)
Command-line home inventory: what you own, where it is and what it is worth, in one encrypted local database per property, with Homebox CSV import and export.

## bm — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/bm)
Browser-independent bookmark store in Bend 2: pulls and merges bookmarks from any browser, keeps folders, classifies new ones, exports csv, json, toon and html.

## finance-rs — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/finance-rs)
Composable financial math for Rust: TVM, XIRR/XNPV, day counts, amortization, portfolio metrics, real estate, venture and fund waterfalls, fixed income.

## kd-library-tooling — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/kd-library-tooling)
kb-root: resolves a knowledge base's configured directories and checks their paths stay consistent.

## cswap-bend — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/cswap-bend)
claude-swap rewritten in Bend 2: keeps several Claude Code accounts, reads each one's 5-hour and 7-day usage, and switches the active login before one runs out.

## bend-toon — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/bend-toon)
TOON (spec v3.3) encoder and decoder for Bend 2; passes all 389 conformance cases (written in Bend).

## bend-lint-rules — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/bend-lint-rules)
Lint rules for Bend 2 programs: dead defs, call-graph fan-in and fan-out, and cyclomatic and cognitive complexity, for the official bend-lint.

## bend-semver-checks — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/bend-semver-checks)
cargo-semver-checks for Bend 2: diffs two versions of a LAWS.bend and flags removed or weakened laws (written in Bend).

## hx-highlight — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/hx-highlight)
Syntax highlighting for contract-defined terms in the Helix editor.

## health-cli — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/health-cli)
health data store + workbook generator

## snaptrade-rs — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/snaptrade-rs)
Unofficial, strongly typed Rust client for the SnapTrade brokerage-aggregation API (signed requests, typed models, pagination, backoff; trading behind an off-by-default feature)

## condorcet — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/condorcet)
Fact-composition engine: SAT core, weighted model counting, Dung argumentation, JSON-declared composers

## shelfmark — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/shelfmark)
Open classification schemes for personal libraries, and a benchmark for scoring them

## formbook — 2026 [legal-tech] (https://github.com/davidawad/formbook)
مجموعة مفتوحة من قوالب إيداع المستندات القضائية المكتوبة بـ Typst؛ يستقبل كل قالب Markdown مع ترويسة YAML، وينظّم حسب المحكمة ونوع المستند.

## eas.el — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/eas.el)
eas.el: an Emacs-native, interactive, agent-drivable chart engine (Vega-Lite subset, SVG + terminal text)

## genome-cli — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/genome-cli)
Personal genomic data CLI: 23andMe/Ancestry array exports, whole-genome VCF and FASTQ, encrypted at rest

## health-charts.el — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/health-charts.el)
Health and biomarker charts and Org reports in Emacs (Vega-Lite and gnuplot)

## genetics.el — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/genetics.el)
Emacs package for consumer genetics raw data: 23andMe/Ancestry/MyHeritage/FTDNA exports, whole-genome VCFs and FASTQ via genome-cli

## fastq-mode — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/fastq-mode)
Fast FASTQ viewer for Emacs: streaming .fastq.gz, base and quality coloring, Phred at point, stats

## whatsapp-link-rs — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/whatsapp-link-rs)
Link a WhatsApp account and read and send messages from Rust, by driving wuzapi over stdio JSON-RPC

## slack-impersona-rs — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/slack-impersona-rs)
Rust library and CLI for Slack's Web API as a signed-in user (xoxc token + d cookie); read-only by default, no Slack app

## etm — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/etm)
Drive a running Emacs from outside: workspaces, panes and terminals as JSON verbs (ntm/tmux robot mode, for Emacs)

## biomarker-cli — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/biomarker-cli)
A command-line tool for storing biomarker data and generating health reports.

## edgar.el — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/edgar.el)
Read SEC EDGAR filings in Emacs (requires xbrl.el)

## xbrl.el — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/xbrl.el)
SEC XBRL financial facts for Emacs (data.sec.gov JSON APIs)

## financial-charts.el — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/financial-charts.el)
Financial charts in Emacs: candlesticks, area, line, sparkline, option payoff and P/L bars as unicode text or SVG, from plain Lisp data. Validate/explain/describe API and a JSON CLI.

## schwab-broker.el — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/schwab-broker.el)
Pure-Elisp, read-only client for the Charles Schwab Trader & Market Data APIs

## alpaca-broker.el — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/alpaca-broker.el)
Pure-Elisp, read-only client for the Alpaca Markets API (market data, account, positions)

## litgraph — 2026 [legal-tech] (https://github.com/davidawad/litgraph)
Litigation procedure graphs as stochastic games: compose forums, custom cost/utility functions, solve, simulate (Rust)

## helix-bend — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/helix-bend)
Bend 2 support for the Helix editor: language entry, highlight queries, and an install script (Helix has no plugin system)

## tree-sitter-bend2 — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/tree-sitter-bend2)
Tree-sitter grammar for Bend 2 (bendlang/bend) — vendored by Helix, nvim-treesitter, and bend.vim

## bend.vim — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/bend.vim)
Tree-sitter grammar for Bend 2, plus a Vim/Neovim plugin (classic syntax layer for both, tree-sitter highlighting for Neovim)

## bend-mode.el — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/bend-mode.el)
Emacs major mode for Bend 2 (bendlang/bend): syntax highlighting, indentation, Eglot formatting, and Flymake diagnostics.

## chwrite — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/chwrite)
Flexible file-write lock so coding agents can't write sensitive code. Configure once and self-installs on clone. 

## oil-cop — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/oil-cop)
Color-coded visibility CLI for Gas City stacks (rigs, agents, bead queues)

## docdiff — 2026 [legal-tech] (https://github.com/davidawad/docdiff)
Compare document revisions and surface meaningful textual changes.

## mayor-correspondence — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/mayor-correspondence)
allows you to chat with the mayor of gastown on multiple chat platforms

## Seshat — 2026 [tool] (https://github.com/davidawad/Seshat)
Open Source Cloud-hosted Quizlet alt. 

## DW3 Cardbattle — 2026 [game] (https://gitlab.com/davidawad/DW3-Cardbattle)
A collectible card battle game built around the DW3 setting.

## Civ Pro: The Gathering — 2026 [legal-tech] (https://civ-pro-the-gathering-97ee4c.gitlab.io/drill/)
Papers, Please for the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure — drill litigation situations, get sanctioned by rule and subsection when you blow one.

## Contract Variable Highlighter — 2024 [legal-tech]
أداة تمييز بأسلوب VS Code تعثر على كل مصطلح معرَّف في العقد وتلوّنه ليتمكن المحامون من اكتشاف أخطاء الصياغة.

## TISLA Student Loan FAQ — 2021 [legal-tech] (https://github.com/davidawad/TISLA_FAQ)
أسئلة شائعة مفتوحة المصدر عن القروض الطلابية لصالح معهد مستشاري القروض الطلابية.

## thoth — 2020 [tool] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/thoth)
تدوين ملاحظات من الطرفية مع معاينة markdown مُصيَّرة.

## Read-Between-The-Lines — 2018 [legal-tech] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/Read-Between-The-Lines)
أداة معالجة لغة طبيعية تقارن نسختين من عقد وتُبرز التغييرات الجوهرية.

## capstone — 2018 [ml] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/capstone)
مشروع التخرج للسيارة ذاتية القيادة — نظام ROS كامل: إدراك وتخطيط وتحكم.

## traffic-sign-classifier — 2017 [ml] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/traffic-sign-classifier)
شبكة CNN عميقة تصنّف إشارات المرور الألمانية — من برنامج Udacity للسيارات ذاتية القيادة.

## lane-detection — 2017 [ml] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/lane-detection)
خط معالجة OpenCV يكتشف خطوط المسارات من كاميرا قيادة أمامية.

## Behavioral-Cloning — 2017 [ml] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/Behavioral-Cloning)
شبكة عصبية شاملة تتعلم قيادة السيارة من صور الكاميرا الأمامية وحدها.

## hi.rd — 2017 [web] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/hi.rd)
مختصِر روابط صغير مع تحليلات للنقرات.

## vehicle-detection — 2017 [ml] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/vehicle-detection)
خط معالجة SVM + HOG يحدد كل سيارة في إطار كاميرا القيادة.

## advanced-lane-detection — 2017 [ml] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/advanced-lane-detection)
تحويل منظوري وملاءمة كثيرات حدود لتتبع المسارات المنحنية تحت الظل والوهج.

## insightweets — 2016 [web] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/insightweets)
لوحة تحليل مشاعر لتغريدات مستخدم على تويتر.

## Archangel Raphael's Mission — 2016 [nonprofit] (http://armnewbrunswick.org)
الموقع والبنية التشغيلية للجمعية الخيرية 501(c)(3) التي شارك ديفيد في تأسيسها — حمامات متنقلة ووجبات وخدمات نظافة للمشردين.

## blocky — 2016 [web] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/blocky)
لعبة ألغاز دفع المكعبات في المتصفح.

## ironmyo — 2016 [embedded] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/ironmyo)
واجهة لسوار Myo تتيح التحكم بعناصر HUD على طريقة Iron Man بإيماءات اليد.

## Waves — 2016 [physics] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/Waves)
محاكاة عددية لمعادلة الموجة ثنائية الأبعاد، كُتبت لمقرر جامعي في المعادلات التفاضلية الجزئية.

## kinectsentrygun — 2015 [embedded] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/kinectsentrygun)
مدفع حراسة يتتبع الحركة عبر Kinect ويتبع الشخص في أرجاء الغرفة.

## spaceshare — 2015 [web] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/spaceshare)
منصة على غرار Airbnb لمشاركة المساحات المكتبية غير المستخدمة، بُنيت في هاكاثون.

## pebbledex — 2014 [embedded] (https://github.com/DavidAwad/pebbledex)
موسوعة بوكيمون لساعة Pebble الذكية — كل بوكيمون على معصمك.
